fingerprint.structure: 6 slides: hook ('SMALL ARMS?') → anatomy overview ('DO THIS', 3 muscle insets around the mascot) → 4 muscle slides (triceps lateral, triceps long head, biceps, forearm), each with 'CHOOSE ONE:' + 3 exercise thumbnails and a large mascot with the target muscle highlighted red. No CTA
fingerprint.hook: Two-word problem question 'SMALL ARMS?' over the mascot curling a dumbbell, on a grey circle
fingerprint.camera_motion: 2d-characters (mascot) on designed cards; larger mascot figures than the other formats; 4:5 slides
fingerprint.pacing: 6 slides, no body text; each muscle slide = heading + sets x reps + 3 thumbnails + one big figure
fingerprint.text_overlay: Headings: Anton-like condensed heavy grotesque, Title Case (ALL CAPS on covers), navy #041732 with accent blue; '#N' numerals in blue, slightly italic; short blue underline (about 12.6% wide) under each heading; body: Didact Gothic-like light sans, gray #4b4945, about 2.7% of frame height, left-aligned at x=10%, 2 to 4 short lines; BLUE BRO logo top-left on every slide; 'CHOOSE ONE:' small caps label above 3 rounded thumbnails with dark name tags; large mascot with red muscle overlay on the right
fingerprint.audio: third-party sound (library-style title and author), not original, no voiceover; slideshow so the sound is only background
fingerprint.arc: Name the problem → show the muscles → pick one of three exercises per muscle (no sell)
